message.content:
Compare the installed slash commands at ~/.claude/commands/ with the source files in ~/Context-Engineering/.claude/commands/. For each agent, show: (1) whether file sizes differ, (2) whether content differs. The installed files are named like `research.md` while the repo files are named like `research.agent.md`. List all agents and their diff status.

Run:
```
for agent in alignment cli comms data deploy diligence doc legal lit marketing meta monitor optimize research security test; do
  installed="$HOME/.claude/commands/${agent}.md"
  repo="$HOME/Context-Engineering/.claude/commands/${agent}.agent.md"
  if [ -f "$installed" ] && [ -f "$repo" ]; then
    installed_size=$(wc -c < "$installed")
    repo_size=$(wc -c < "$repo")
    if diff -q "$installed" "$repo" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "$agent: IDENTICAL (${installed_size}B)"
    else
      echo "$agent: DIFFERS (installed: ${installed_size}B, repo: ${repo_size}B)"
    fi
  elif [ -f "$repo" ] && [ ! -f "$installed" ]; then
    echo "$agent: MISSING (not installed)"
  else
    echo "$agent: installed exists, no repo source"
  fi
done
```
